Connectivity and Zigbee Device Discovery Endpoints

Source: R/api-connectivity.R
hue_connectivity.Rd

Monitor and manage wireless connectivity services on a Philips Hue Bridge v2 or Bridge Pro, including Zigbee (/clip/v2/resource/zigbee_connectivity), Zigbee Green Power (/clip/v2/resource/zgp_connectivity), Wi-Fi (/clip/v2/resource/wifi_connectivity), and Zigbee pairing discovery (/clip/v2/resource/zigbee_device_discovery).

Usage

hue_get_zigbee_connectivities(bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_zigbee_connectivity(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_zgp_connectivities(bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_zgp_connectivity(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_wifi_connectivities(bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_wifi_connectivity(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_update_wifi_connectivity(id, body, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_zigbee_device_discoveries(bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_get_zigbee_device_discovery(id, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

hue_update_zigbee_device_discovery(id, body, bridge = NULL, tidy = TRUE)

Arguments

bridge

Optional hue_bridge object created by hue_bridge(). If NULL, resolves from session defaults set by hue_auth() or environment variables.

tidy

Logical scalar. If TRUE (default), returns a tibble parsed via jsonlite. If FALSE, returns the raw parsed R list.

id

Character scalar. UUID of the connectivity or discovery resource.

body

Named list representing the CLIP API v2 JSON payload.

Value

A tibble (or list when tidy = FALSE) containing the bridge response data array.

Details

Supported CLIP API v2 endpoints:

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/zigbee_connectivity — hue_get_zigbee_connectivities()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/zigbee_connectivity/{id} — hue_get_zigbee_connectivity()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/zgp_connectivity — hue_get_zgp_connectivities()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/zgp_connectivity/{id} — hue_get_zgp_connectivity()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/wifi_connectivity — hue_get_wifi_connectivities()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/wifi_connectivity/{id} — hue_get_wifi_connectivity()

  • PUT /clip/v2/resource/wifi_connectivity/{id} — hue_update_wifi_connectivity()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/zigbee_device_discovery — hue_get_zigbee_device_discoveries()

  • GET /clip/v2/resource/zigbee_device_discovery/{id} — hue_get_zigbee_device_discovery()

  • PUT /clip/v2/resource/zigbee_device_discovery/{id} — hue_update_zigbee_device_discovery()

See also

hue_devices

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zigbee <- hue_get_zigbee_connectivities()
wifi <- hue_get_wifi_connectivities()
} # }
